cuts.ofreeRecent: a present-day seaside arcade with a glass prize-claw machine filled with folded plush stars — using the claw-machine joystick with a sharpshooter’s patience; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; an indoor climbing wall of coloured holds — kneeling on the ground; a far-future orbital hotel recreation pool under a transparent observation dome — trying the low-gravity relaxation deck after a swim; a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — swimming breaststroke; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — standing with one foot up on a step; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — kneeling on the ground; an airport lounge — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing
